asr_text: 11 labs agent tools, which type do you need? Act in the user's browser or app, use a client tool. A single API call with no custom logic, a webhook tool. Calculations or merging APIs, a code tool, it's enterprise only. Tools from an MCP server, use MCP with always ask approval. And built -in actions like ending a call, a system tool. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 20.
